kind: dry-run patch: not merged into placement.json
intent: Fill the food chain of level 1 to the absorb gate: every 0.05 m rung from 0.30 to 2.20 m gets newly-edible props, the 2.20 m cap becomes reachable, and the supply ratio reaches >= 3x at each star. Sized so that each prop sits at 0.85-1.0 of the gate of the rung it belongs to (the absorb step is set by volume, not by count).
placementRules: every prop sits on the level floor (support omitted -> ground plane y=0)
AABB inside level.bounds with the 0.05 m margin the validator allows
>= 1.0 m clear of ballStart and playerSpawn (spawnClearanceM)

zones by radius from ballStart: 0.30-0.40 m items in the 1.1-2.5 m ring, the 1.6-2.2 m class only beyond 7 m (small clusters centrally, bigger items sparser and further out, ContentVolume section 4.4)
no prop/prop AABB overlap above 5 % of the smaller (packed with a 15 mm gap)
no new prop inside a solid structure (flower bed, ramps, signpost, tree mound)
yaw only, from an 8-value set; a yaw keeps the bottom face horizontal so the seated-on-floor rule is unaffected

zone: a new prop takes the zone of the nearest existing prop's zone centroid (everything on the flower bed is bed_top); the label only groups the report table, it changes nothing about placement or gameplay
